polyec.prompt: Read AGENTS.md then docs/CURRENT_TASK.md before working. Use its active reviewed contract and bounded file/test scope. docs/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md defines project scope; docs/DEVELOPER_GUIDE.md explains methods and limitations. docs/archive, reports and artifacts are historical/evidence, not active instructions; open only if needed for provenance. Work sequentially within the current milestone. Do not spawn subagents. Shell is Windows PowerShell: use native PowerShell commands, never Unix head/tail, bash syntax or shell command substitution. Preserve existing work and avoid files being edited by another active task. Report only checks actually executed; update CURRENT_TASK on handoff and DEVELOPMENT_HISTORY on acceptance. Do not commit, push, publish or purchase services.
